reference: Inspected approved https://arkodia.online/world-map-review/v1/concept.png and existing terrain Knowledge before generation
sharedBaseBrief: Individual square seamless tileable base-color PNG; Arkadia Frozen Frontier dark gritty hand-painted realism, muted cold gray palette, strict orthographic vertical top-down flat 3 metre square, uniform diffuse ambient light, full-bleed opaque surface; no directional cast shadows, vignette, border, vegetation, buildings, objects, footprints, text or perspective.

materials.snow-ground: dirty ash-gray snow, fine granular frost
materials.packed-snow: compressed granular cold gray crust, understated dirty scuffs
materials.frozen-dirt: cold charcoal gray-brown frozen mineral soil, fine frost grains and shallow fissures
materials.cracked-ice: muted slate blue-gray cloudy opaque ice with shallow branching pale fissures
materials.rocky-ground: flat embedded angular charcoal gray fragments in frozen grit
materials.ruined-stone-paving: flat weathered rectangular pavers 30–50cm, chipped edges and shallow frost joints

transitionBrief: Left material A, right material B, centered gentle irregular vertical boundary, pure material at outer left/right 20%; top/bottom edges requested periodic, same 3 metre scale and lighting constraints.
